name: tersign
description: Counter-signed evidence for agent commerce. Verify any counterparty's x402 receipt, action record or evidence bundle OFFLINE with no account and no API key; issue counter-signed receipts and disclosure records into a neutral hash-chained ledger anchored to Bitcoin; export a dispute-ready envelope for the venue that will hear it. Needs no configuration: the first call self-provisions a signer-keyed account, and no key is ever collected by this plugin.
